title: RidgeExtractor shared params
description: Shared extractor params used by all four LineContinuity modes (Terminations, PatternChange, Correlation, Density). All four modes receive the same params dict; only relevant fields are used per mode.

blur_method.description: Blur method applied before gradient computation. 'none' skips blurring.

blur_kernel.description: Gaussian blur kernel size (must be odd). Only used when blur_method = 'gaussian'.

bilateral_d.description: Bilateral filter diameter. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_color.description: Bilateral filter sigma in color space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

bilateral_sigma_space.description: Bilateral filter sigma in coordinate space. Only used when blur_method = 'bilateral'.

gradient_method.description: Sobel gradient direction used to build the ridge magnitude map. 'xy' = combined (default, keeps current behaviour). 'x' = |Gx| (vertical ridges only). 'y' = |Gy| (horizontal ridges). 'none' = use pixel intensity directly.

gradient_ksize.description: Sobel kernel size. Use 3, 5, or 7 (odd values only).

gradient_direction.description: Gradient direction for Sobel operator. 'xy' uses combined magnitude.

ridge_threshold.description: Minimum gradient magnitude to flag a pixel as a ridge.

angle_tolerance.description: ±degrees from horizontal accepted as a vertical-line gradient. Smaller = stricter vertical orientation filter.

morph_kernel_height.description: Height (rows) of the morphological structuring element used for close/open operations.

morph_kernel_width.description: Width (cols) of the morphological structuring element.

morph_iterations.description: Number of morphological close/open iterations. 0 = disabled.

morph_close_enabled.description: Apply morphological closing to connect nearby ridge pixels.

morph_open_enabled.description: Apply morphological opening to remove small isolated ridge pixels.

band_height.description: Row count of each comparison band for pattern/correlation/density signals.

termination_window.description: ±row window for aggregating termination counts. 0 = exact row only.

use_ab.description: True = use A:B accumulated difference frames; False = single frame.
